title: 第13章 这人究竟是什么人第14章 请您救救他
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
可这年龄可都比她还大了，居然还敢肖想她儿子！
盛素华和郁颜的想法一致，两人都怒视着张芷。
“不过是个经理，我还以为是你以前公司的董事长，本事不大，口气倒挺大的。”郁凡想到自己的孙子在公司被压榨的几年，对这人自然是不喜的。
“你！”张芷差点被气炸。
“你们有什么资格来说我没本事，也不看看你们一脸穷酸样，来这边是为了什么谁知道呢。”
看这群人都长相相似，想来应该是郁景的家人。
就郁景这要背景没背景，要钱没钱的人，他的家人能有多大能耐？
她冷笑了一声，“虽然我不知道你们是来做什么的，但我却可以让你们进不去。”
她对着酒店内的服务人员招了招手，服务人员立马走了过来。
“张小姐，您有什么事情吗？”很显然，这服务员是认识张芷的。
“这几个人，我怀疑他们想要干扰酒店的正常运行，你们还是小心点，最好不要让他们这些人进来。”
那服务员看了看郁凡一家，觉得郁凡那气势不太像是来找事的，反而是眼前这女人......
可是想到这个女人是他们总经理的妻子，得罪了总经理可没有什么好果子吃。
于是，他只能客气的对郁凡他们说：“不好意思，请你们马上离开这里。”
郁嘉庆没想到这里的服务员居然如此的不分是非黑白，有些气怒。
“我们是和人约好了，你不让我们进去，耽误了事情你能负得了责任吗？”
“这......”服务员有些犹豫，来者都是客，这样明目张胆的赶走客人确实不太好。
“你看他们这一家人，像是能和这边贵客有约定的吗？”张芷翻了翻白眼，“现在的人吹牛都不用打草稿了。”
“怎么回事？”酒店总经理范成快步走过来。
“你怎么才过来？不是说了让你来了就去找我吗？”

张芷看到自己老公来了，更是抬高了下巴，“还不是这几个人耽误了我，老公，这几个人想要趁机进酒店去骚扰客人呢。”
“这些都是什么人？”范成随意的看了一眼，“行了，这种事情，叫保安处理好就行了。”
作为海市排名前三的酒店总经理，他见得大人物可多着去了，自然不会将这些平民放在眼中。
“对了，今天有贵客要来，小于，你仔细着点。”对那个服务员说完后，便叫张芷赶紧进去。
张芷得意的点点头，不屑的瞥了一眼郁景一眼，便跟着走了进去。
“几位，这，我们总经理已经下了命令，您看...”服务员小于无奈的下着逐客令。
但就在这时，王老已经急匆匆的走了出来。
“郁神医，您来了。”王老恭敬的朝着郁凡躬了躬身。“景焕也没提前跟我说您来了的事情，刚才问他才知道，我没有及时迎接到您，深表歉意。”
郁凡点点头说道：“无碍。”
“不过，这个酒店我看我还是不进了。”
“这？”王老一脸疑惑的看向郁嘉庆。
content_en:
But he was older than her, yet he still dared to miss her son!
Sheng Suhua and Yu Yan had the same idea, and they both glared at Zhang Zhi.
"He's just a manager. I thought he was the chairman of your previous company. He's not very capable, but his tone is quite loud." Yu Fan thought of his grandson's years of being squeezed in the company, and naturally he didn't like this person.
"You!" Zhang Zhi was almost furious.
"What qualifications do you have to say that I have no ability? I don't even look at your poor faces. Who knows why I'm here."
Seeing that these people all look similar, they must be Yu Jing’s family members.
For someone like Yu Jing, who has no background and no background, and wants money but no money, how capable can his family be?
She sneered, "Although I don't know what you are here for, I can prevent you from entering."
She waved to the service staff in the hotel, who came over immediately.
"Miss Zhang, what can I do for you?" It was obvious that the waiter knew Zhang Zhi.
"These people, I suspect they want to interfere with the normal operation of the hotel. You'd better be careful and don't let them in."
The waiter looked at Yu Fan's family and felt that Yu Fan's aura did not look like he was looking for trouble, but rather the woman in front of him...
But considering that this woman is the wife of their general manager, there is no good fruit to be gained by offending the general manager.
So, he could only politely say to Yu Fan and the others: "I'm sorry, please leave here immediately."
Yu Jiaqing didn't expect that the waiters here would be so indifferent to right and wrong, and he was a little angry.
"We made an appointment with someone, but if you don't let us in, can you take the responsibility for delaying things?"
"This..." The waiter was a little hesitant. Everyone who came was a customer, so it was really not good to drive them away so blatantly.
"Do you think this family can have an agreement with this distinguished guest?" Zhang Zhi rolled his eyes, "Nowadays, people don't need to make drafts when they brag."
"What's going on?" Fan Cheng, the general manager of the hotel, walked over quickly.
"Why did you come here? Didn't I tell you to find me when you came?"
Zhang Zhi raised her chin when she saw her husband coming, "It's not like these people have delayed me. Husband, these people want to take the opportunity to enter the hotel and harass the guests."
"Who are these people?" Fan Cheng glanced casually, "Okay, just ask the security to handle this kind of thing."
As the general manager of the top three hotels in Hai City, he has seen many big shots, so naturally he will not take these common people seriously.
"By the way, there are distinguished guests coming today, Yu Yu, please be careful." After saying this to the waiter, he asked Zhang Zhi to hurry in.
Zhang Zhi nodded proudly, glanced at Yu Jing disdainfully, and followed him in.
"Guys, here, our general manager has issued an order, you see..." The waiter Yu Yue helplessly issued an order to expel the guests.
But at this moment, Mr. Wang had already walked out in a hurry.
"Doctor Yu, you are here." Mr. Wang bowed respectfully towards Yu Fan. "Jing Huan didn't tell me in advance about your arrival. I only found out when I asked him just now. I apologize for not being able to greet you in time."
Yu Fan nodded and said, "No problem."
"However, I don't think I can enter this hotel anymore."
"This?" Mr. Wang looked at Yu Jiaqing with a puzzled look.
